title: Bright Toddlers Remember Every Clue, Yet One Moved Marble Stumps Them
description:
You think bright kids easily split truth from belief! Yet a moved marble fools almost every young child! This is the true story of Alan Leslie's London doll study. Here is what went wrong across a playroom table.
